quests.instruction: I have tall branching antlers. I live grazing quietly in the forest. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the deer! It has tall branching antlers and lives grazing quietly in the forest.
quests.funFact: Did you know? male deer grow a new set of antlers every single year.

quests.instruction: I have a hard shell and two strong pincers. I live scuttling along the sandy beach. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the crab! It has a hard shell and two strong pincers and lives scuttling along the sandy beach.
quests.funFact: Most crabs walk and swim completely sideways.

quests.instruction: I have a very long trunk and big flappy ears. I live in the wild jungle. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the elephant! It has a very long trunk and big flappy ears and lives in the wild jungle.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: elephants are the only animals that cannot jump.

quests.instruction: Which animal can wade through water, surprisingly fast?
quests.question: Wade through water, surprisingly fast
quests.hint: This animal lives cooling off in a river.
quests.explanation: Yes! The hippo can wade through water, surprisingly fast. It has a huge mouth and short round legs.
quests.funFact: Hippos secrete a natural pink fluid that acts like sunscreen.

quests.instruction: I have a fluffy woolly coat. I live on a green farm. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the sheep! It has a fluffy woolly coat and lives on a green farm.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: sheep have excellent memories and can remember dozens of different faces.

quests.instruction: I have bright pink feathers and long thin legs. I live wading in a shallow, pink-tinted lake. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the flamingo! It has bright pink feathers and long thin legs and lives wading in a shallow, pink-tinted lake.
quests.funFact: Flamingos turn pink because of the shrimp and algae they eat.

quests.instruction: I have thick fur and sharp claws. I live in a den in the forest. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the bear! It has thick fur and sharp claws and lives in a den in the forest.
quests.funFact: Bears have an excellent sense of smell, better than dogs.

quests.instruction: I have skin that can change color. I live hiding among jungle leaves. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the chameleon! It has skin that can change color and lives hiding among jungle leaves.
quests.funFact: Chameleons change color to communicate and regulate their temperature.

quests.instruction: A group of bats has a special name. What is it?
quests.question: Bat
quests.hint: Think about where bats usually live: flying through the night sky.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of bats is called a colony. They like to stay together flying through the night sky.
quests.funFact: A large group of ants or penguins living together is called a colony.

quests.instruction: I have webbed feet made for paddling. I live on a farm near the water. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the duck! It has webbed feet made for paddling and lives on a farm near the water.
quests.funFact: Amazing! ducks have special waterproof feathers that keep them completely dry.

quests.instruction: I have a long neck and orange webbed feet. I live on a farm pond. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the goose! It has a long neck and orange webbed feet and lives on a farm pond.
quests.funFact: Did you know? geese fly in a V-formation to save energy on long journeys.

quests.instruction: I have short horns and a little beard. I live on a rocky farm hillside. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the goat! It has short horns and a little beard and lives on a rocky farm hillside.
quests.funFact: Did you know? goats have rectangular pupils that give them excellent peripheral vision.

quests.instruction: Who is able to walk slowly, then charge fast? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Walk slowly, then charge fast
quests.hint: This animal lives grazing on the open plains.
quests.explanation: Yes! The rhino can walk slowly, then charge fast. It has one or two horns and very thick skin.
quests.funFact: A rhino's horn is made of keratin, the exact same stuff as human hair and nails.

quests.instruction: I have five arms shaped like a star. I live resting on the ocean floor. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the starfish! It has five arms shaped like a star and lives resting on the ocean floor.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: starfish can actually regrow lost arms.

quests.instruction: I have orange fur with black stripes. I live prowling through the jungle. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the tiger! It has orange fur with black stripes and lives prowling through the jungle.
quests.funFact: Every single tiger has a completely unique pattern of stripes.

quests.instruction: What do we call a baby duck?
quests.question: Duck
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like webbed feet made for paddling.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby duck is called a duckling. Grown-up ducks live on a farm near the water.
quests.funFact: A baby duck is called a duckling, and they love to swim.

quests.instruction: Who is able to leap and run gracefully? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Leap and run gracefully
quests.hint: This animal lives grazing quietly in the forest.
quests.explanation: Yes! The deer can leap and run gracefully. It has tall branching antlers.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: male deer grow a new set of antlers every single year.

quests.instruction: A group of hippos has a special name. What is it?
quests.question: Hippo
quests.hint: Think about where hippos usually live: cooling off in a river.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of hippos is called a pod. They like to stay together cooling off in a river.
quests.funFact: A group of dolphins or whales traveling together is called a pod.

quests.instruction: I have eight long, wiggly arms. I live hiding among ocean rocks. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the octopus! It has eight long, wiggly arms and lives hiding among ocean rocks.
quests.funFact: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.

quests.instruction: Where would you find this animal? Who lives in the ocean?
quests.question: In the ocean
quests.hint: Look for the animal with a curly tail and a horse-shaped head.
quests.explanation: Great job! The seahorse lives in the ocean. You can spot it by a curly tail and a horse-shaped head.
quests.funFact: Did you know? male seahorses are the ones who carry and give birth to the babies.

quests.instruction: I have black and yellow stripes and tiny wings. I live buzzing around flowers in a garden. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the bee! It has black and yellow stripes and tiny wings and lives buzzing around flowers in a garden.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: bees perform a waggle dance to show others where flowers are.

quests.instruction: I have a big bushy tail and quick little paws. I live scampering up trees in the forest. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the squirrel! It has a big bushy tail and quick little paws and lives scampering up trees in the forest.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: squirrels plant thousands of new trees each year simply by forgetting where they hid their acorns.

quests.instruction: I have a curly tail and a horse-shaped head. I live drifting near ocean seaweed. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the seahorse! It has a curly tail and a horse-shaped head and lives drifting near ocean seaweed.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: male seahorses are the ones who carry and give birth to the babies.

quests.instruction: A baby camel has a special name. What is it called?
quests.question: Camel
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like one or two humps on the back.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby camel is called a calf. Grown-up camels live walking across the hot, sandy desert.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a baby cow is called a calf, and they can stand up shortly after being born.

quests.instruction: I have shiny orange scales and gentle fins. I live swimming in a bowl or a pond. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the goldfish! It has shiny orange scales and gentle fins and lives swimming in a bowl or a pond.
quests.funFact: Goldfish actually have very good memories and can recognize faces.

quests.instruction: Can you spot the animal with a curly tail and a horse-shaped head?
quests.question: A curly tail and a horse-shaped head
quests.hint: This animal usually lives drifting near ocean seaweed.
quests.explanation: That's right! The seahorse has a curly tail and a horse-shaped head. You can find it drifting near ocean seaweed.
quests.funFact: Here's a cool fact: male seahorses are the ones who carry and give birth to the babies.

quests.instruction: I have a huge mouth and short round legs. I live cooling off in a river. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the hippo! It has a huge mouth and short round legs and lives cooling off in a river.
quests.funFact: Did you know? hippos secrete a natural pink fluid that acts like sunscreen.

quests.instruction: Which animal eats both plants and meat?
quests.question: Eats Everything
quests.hint: This animal lives strutting through a garden.
quests.explanation: Correct! The peacock eats both plants and meat. It has a giant fan of colorful tail feathers.
quests.funFact: Only male peafowl are called peacocks, and they have the beautiful tail feathers.

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that lives in a garden?
quests.question: In a garden
quests.hint: Look for the animal with eight legs and a silky web.
quests.explanation: Great job! The spider lives in a garden. You can spot it by eight legs and a silky web.
quests.funFact: Fun fact: spiders make silk that is incredibly strong and flexible.

quests.instruction: I have a long body with no legs at all. I live slithering through the grass. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the snake! It has a long body with no legs at all and lives slithering through the grass.
quests.funFact: Snakes use their forked tongues to smell the air around them.
